name: ww-api
description: HERE API proxy for Cloudflare Workers

scripts.deploy: node scripts/r2-lifecycle.mjs ww-buddy-blobs && node scripts/r2-lifecycle.mjs ww-account-backups && node scripts/r2-lifecycle.mjs ww-account-sync && node scripts/r2-lifecycle.mjs ww-account-photos && wrangler deploy --outdir dist --var SENTRY_RELEASE:$(sentry-cli releases propose-version) && pnpm run sentry:sourcemaps
scripts.deploy:beta: node scripts/r2-lifecycle.mjs ww-buddy-blobs-beta && node scripts/r2-lifecycle.mjs ww-account-backups-beta && node scripts/r2-lifecycle.mjs ww-account-sync-beta && node scripts/r2-lifecycle.mjs ww-account-photos-beta && wrangler deploy --env beta --outdir dist --var SENTRY_RELEASE:$(sentry-cli releases propose-version) && pnpm run sentry:sourcemaps
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: sentry-cli releases new $(sentry-cli releases propose-version) && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --release=$(sentry-cli releases propose-version) --strip-prefix 'dist/..' dist
scripts.updates:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply ww-updates-dev --config wrangler-updates.json --env dev --remote
scripts.updates:migrate:beta: wrangler d1 migrations apply ww-updates-beta --config wrangler-updates.json --env beta --remote
scripts.updates:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply ww-updates-prod --config wrangler-updates.json --env prod --remote
